name: Getting Along With Others
overview: Scripture emphasizes the value and beauty of living in unity with others, as seen in Psalms 133:1, which celebrates the goodness of brethren dwelling together in harmony. Wisdom from Proverbs teaches the importance of controlling anger and avoiding strife early, highlighting prudence in passing over offenses and the danger of contentious behavior. Genuine friendship involves honest correction rather than deceitful flattery, underscoring the need for faithfulness in relationships. Finally, Matthew 6:12 calls believers to forgive others as they seek forgiveness themselves, anchoring interpersonal harmony in Christ-centered grace.
